description.en: A narrow trail winds into the hills beyond Fjordhaven. The trees hide most of the view.
description.zh-CN: 峡湾城外，一条狭窄山路蜿蜒向上。大半景色，都被树木遮住了。

description.en: The trail bends between wooded slopes. Branches rustle above the path.
description.zh-CN: 山路在林坡间转折。头顶的枝叶，传来阵阵沙响。

description.en: Rocks crowd the trail as it turns through the trees. Somewhere beyond them, insects hum.
description.zh-CN: 山路绕过密林，岩石挤在两旁。更深处，隐约传来虫鸣。

description.en: The air is warm and still among the high trees. Distant voices mingle with the insects.
description.zh-CN: 高处的树林里，空气温暖而沉静。远处的人声，混在虫鸣之中。

description.en: Quiet courtyards open onto a guarded path into the woods. Circe watches the visitors, while a guard keeps an eye on the inner gate.
description.zh-CN: 清静的庭院连着通往密林的小路。喀耳刻打量着来客，守卫则留意着内庭入口。

description.en: Moss spreads between the roots. The sanctuary falls quiet behind the trees.
description.zh-CN: 苔藓沿树根铺开。树木遮住了圣所，也隔开了那边的声音。

description.en: The paths twist through thick undergrowth. Something stirs whenever the leaves settle.
description.zh-CN: 小路在密集的灌木中转折。叶子刚刚静下来，便又有东西在深处动了动。

description.en: Old roots rise above the soil. A faint hiss travels through the undergrowth.
description.zh-CN: 老树的根露在地面上。低低的嘶声，从灌木间传来。

description.en: The trees thin around a hollow strewn with stones. The shadows beyond them seem unusually still.
description.zh-CN: 树林在一片散落石块的空地旁稀疏起来。更深的阴影里，却安静得有些异样。

description.en: A blade waits in the cavern's still air. The silence feels deliberate.
description.zh-CN: 凝滞的空气中，一柄剑静静等待着。这里的安静，像是有人刻意安排的。

去往云南五毒教.en: Take the hillside trail toward the Venom Circle Sanctuary.

通往五毒教深处.en: A guarded path into the inner woods.
通往五毒教深处.zh-CN: 通往内庭密林的路，由守卫看守。

五毒教教主蓝凤凰.zh-CN: 喀耳刻打量着新来的旅人。

千娇百媚蓝凤凰.en: Circe has noticed the company you're keeping.
千娇百媚蓝凤凰.zh-CN: 喀耳刻留意到了与你同行的人。

五毒教不传之秘.en: A guarded blade. The hero must face its wardens alone.
五毒教不传之秘.zh-CN: 有人守护着这柄剑。主角必须独自面对护卫。

text.en: The inner woods are restricted. You'll need permission to pass.
text.zh-CN: 内庭密林，不对外开放。得到许可后才能通过。

text.en: The inner woods are restricted. Do you have permission?
text.zh-CN: 内庭密林，不对外开放。你有通行许可吗？

text.en: Would this Venom Circle Token do?
text.zh-CN: 这枚毒环会信物，可以吗？

text.en: The Circle's seal. You're cleared to enter.
text.zh-CN: 毒环的印记。你可以进去了。

text.en: Keep to the paths. The sanctuary wardens guard more than the gate.
text.zh-CN: 留意脚下的路。圣所护卫看守的，可不只是入口。

text.en: The Serpent-Gold Sword. Someone has kept it very well hidden.
text.zh-CN: 蛇纹金剑。它可真是藏得够隐蔽的。

text.en: And very well guarded. Here they come!
So much for taking a quick look. Let's get that sword.
text.zh-CN: 看来，随便看看也不轻松。把剑带上吧。
